description: Atlas mouvements de terrains du département de la Côte-d'or is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by atom.geo-ide.application.i2. Ces données sont issues de l'Atlas mouvements de terrains du département de la Côte-d'or datant de 2016 réalisé par le CEREMA (Centre d'études et d'expertise sur les risques, l'environnement, la mobilité et l'aménagement). Coverage: FR. Its keywords include atlas, données ouvertes. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
